name: form-stack
title: FormStack
description: Vertical stack of Fields inside a modal or panel. The single shared layout for create/edit forms: every form gets identical rhythm from one place instead of each page hand-rolling its own flex column.
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/FormStack.json
